name: NGC 1289 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1289, a slowly rotating early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1289-hubble
story: NGC 1289 is a smooth early-type galaxy whose stars turn only slowly, while its heart holds a core that spins the opposite way. Hubble's sharp view of its center found starlight rising steadily inward with no flattened core.

claims.text: NGC 1289 is one of the slowly rotating early-type galaxies newly imaged by Hubble program GO-13324
NGC 1289's nuclear light profile is a power law, classed as core-less
NGC 1289 was a target of Hubble program 13324 on cores in early-type galaxies
